# Copilot Instructions for Google Sheets App Script Project

- [x] Clarify Project Requirements
  - Project type: Google Sheets App Script
  - Language: JavaScript (App Script flavor)

- [x] Scaffold the Project
  - Create a sample script file (`Code.js`) with a simple function.
  - Add a README.md with instructions for deploying to Google Sheets.

- [ ] Customize the Project
  - Add more features or functions as requested by the user.

- [x] Install Required Extensions
  - No extensions required for App Script development in VS Code.

- [x] Compile the Project
  - No compilation required for App Script projects.

- [x] Create and Run Task
  - No tasks required for App Script projects.

- [x] Launch the Project
  - Deployment is done via Google Apps Script editor, not locally.

- [ ] Ensure Documentation is Complete
  - Ensure README.md and copilot-instructions.md are up to date.

## Execution Guidelines
- Use the current directory as the project root.
- Keep explanations concise and focused.
- Avoid adding unnecessary files or media.
- If the user requests additional features, update the checklist and project accordingly.
